boards.school_name: CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.description: A guide to the essential under-21-safe late-night dining spots near the John Jay campus in Hell's Kitchen, featuring 24-hour diners, iconic pizza, and local favorites.

cards.title: 24-Hour Comfort at The Flame
cards.subtitle: Classic Diner Fare
cards.notes: Visit this 24/7 staple for classic burgers and breakfast platters. It is a reliable spot for late-night study breaks just blocks from the New Building.
cards.short_summary: A quintessential 24-hour New York diner located at the corner of 9th Avenue and 58th Street, serving a full menu all night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Flame Diner is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, offering a diverse menu including breakfast and late-night bites.
cards.source_title: The Flame Diner NY New York Delivery and Pickup menu
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: Mama's Midnight Empanadas
cards.subtitle: Latin Late-Night Staples
cards.notes: Choose from over 40 flavors of empanadas at any hour. This vibrant spot is a favorite for quick, flavorful bites after evening classes.
cards.short_summary: A popular Hell's Kitchen destination known for a vast selection of Colombian-style empanadas and Latin comfort food, open 24/7.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hell's Kitchen location of Empanada Mama at 765 9th Ave is open 24/7.
cards.source_title: Hell's Kitchen Empanadas | Dine-In, Delivery, & Takeout NYC
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for dine-in and takeout.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Grocery Run
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Essentials
cards.notes: Grab fresh fruit, snacks, or a meal from the salad bar at this 24-hour grocer. It is the go-to for students needing supplies at odd hours.
cards.short_summary: A full-service supermarket located on 9th Avenue that remains open 24 hours a day, providing a reliable source for groceries and prepared foods.
cards.evidence_claim: The Morton Williams location at 917 Ninth Avenue (59th Street) is open 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: LOCATIONS | mortonwilliams
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Warm Cookies Until 3 AM
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Sweet Treats
cards.notes: Satisfy a late-night sugar craving with warm cookies delivered or picked up. The 10th Avenue location serves the campus area well into the night.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in warm cookies and milk, famous for its late-night operating hours and delivery service.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies locations typically stay open until 1 a.m. or 3 a.m., providing late-night treats to the local community.
cards.source_title: Find an Insomnia Cookies Location Near You | Store Finder
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM or 3:00 AM depending on the day.

cards.title: The Iconic Broadway Slice
cards.subtitle: Classic NY Street Pizza
cards.notes: Grab a classic New York slice at this legendary pizzeria. It is a frequent stop for students heading to or from the Columbus Circle transit hub.
cards.short_summary: An outpost of the famous Greenwich Village institution, serving authentic New York street slices until the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joe's Pizza location at 1435 Broadway offers online ordering and pickup until 4:25 a.m.
cards.source_title: Joe's Pizza - New York, NY - 1435 Broadway
cards.access_notes: Open until 4:25 AM for pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Weekend 24-Hour Diner
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Square Comfort
cards.notes: Enjoy diner classics in a family-run atmosphere. It is particularly useful for weekend late-night meals when it operates 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood diner near Lincoln Square offering American comfort food and extensive breakfast options.
cards.evidence_claim: Morning Star Cafe is open 24 hours from Friday through Sunday to serve the community day and night.
cards.source_title: Morning Star Cafe New York NY Delivery and Pickup menu
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Friday-Sunday; closes at midnight Monday-Thursday.

cards.title: Heavy Slices Until 4 AM
cards.subtitle: Signature Thick Crust
cards.notes: Try the famous artichoke slice or a classic Margherita. The thick crust and rich toppings make it a substantial late-night meal option.
cards.short_summary: Known for its massive, creamy artichoke slices, this pizza chain is a staple of the New York late-night food scene.
cards.evidence_claim: The Times Square location at 1410 Broadway is open 7 days a week from 10:30 a.m. to 4:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Order Online | Artichoke Basille's Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 4:00 AM.

cards.title: 24-Hour Coffee & Donuts
cards.subtitle: Reliable Caffeine Fix
cards.notes: Get a late-night coffee or snack at this 24-hour location. It is a convenient stop for students studying late or commuting through 57th Street.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Dunkin' location providing coffee, donuts, and breakfast sandwiches at all hours of the day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 977 8th Ave (57th St) is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' locations in New York City
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Iconic Platter at the Original Cart
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Street Food
cards.notes: Join the line for the famous chicken and gyro platters with white sauce. It is a short walk from campus and a quintessential NYC late-night experience.
cards.short_summary: The world-famous street food cart that started a global franchise, still serving its signature platters late into the night at its original corner.
cards.evidence_claim: The original Halal Guys cart at 53rd Street and 6th Avenue is open until 4:00 a.m. or 5:00 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: New York, NY | The Halal Guys - Gyro and Chicken
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 4:00 AM or later.

cards.title: Traditional Greek Fare
cards.subtitle: Midtown West Mediterranean
cards.notes: Enjoy gyros and moussaka until 10 PM. While not open past midnight, it serves as a reliable late-dinner option for students finishing evening sessions.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned restaurant serving traditional Greek cuisine, including gyros, salads, and seafood, in a casual setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greek Kitchen at 889 10th Ave is open daily until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: THE GREEK KITCHEN – 889 10th Avenue, New York
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 10:00 PM.

boards.school_name: CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student spaces and quiet corners at John Jay College, from the elevated Jay Walk to specialized library study rooms and cultural galleries.

cards.title: The Jay Walk
cards.subtitle: Rooftop Commons
cards.notes: Relax on this 1.5-acre rooftop park connecting Haaren Hall and the New Building. It features lawn areas and seating for outdoor study sessions.
cards.short_summary: An elevated green roof and park-like commons connecting the college's main buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jay Walk is a rooftop outdoor environment connecting Haaren Hall and the New Building with lawn areas and seating.
cards.source_title: Jay Walk Use Policies & Operating Hours - John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the 2nd floor of the New Building or Haaren Hall during campus operating hours.

cards.title: Niederhoffer Lounge
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall 1st Floor
cards.notes: Find a seat in this lounge located at the entrance of the Lloyd Sealy Library. It is a convenient spot for quick breaks between research sessions.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge located on the first floor of Haaren Hall near the library entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Niederhoffer Lounge is located on the first floor of Haaren Hall, flanking the library entrance.
cards.source_title: Lloyd Sealy Library - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Located inside Haaren Hall; open during library operating hours.

cards.title: Anya and Andrew Shiva Gallery
cards.subtitle: New Building Ground Floor
cards.notes: Visit this 4,000-square-foot gallery to view art exhibitions focused on social justice and politics. It is located near the 11th Avenue entrance.
cards.short_summary: The primary fine art gallery at John Jay College, featuring justice-themed exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shiva Gallery is a 4,000-square-foot art facility located on the ground floor of the New Building at 11th Avenue and 59th Street.
cards.source_title: About Us – Shiva Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open to the public and students; check gallery website for current exhibition hours.

cards.title: Haaren Hall Cyber Lounge
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Use the computer workstations in this tech-focused lounge on the second floor of Haaren Hall. It is supported by the Student Technology Fee.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped student lounge and computer lab located in Haaren Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cyber Lounge in Haaren Hall is located on the 2nd floor and provides open access to computer facilities.
cards.source_title: Cyber Cafe & Lounges - John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Available to students with valid ID during college operating hours.

cards.entity_name: Lloyd Sealy Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Quiet Study Area South
cards.notes: Reserve one of four private rooms on the library's upper level for focused work or online exams. They include power outlets and a small desk.
cards.short_summary: Private, single-occupancy study rooms located in the Quiet Study Area of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers four individual study rooms in Quiet Study Area South on the upper level, ideal for independent study.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Upstairs 3: Individual Study Room - LibCal
cards.access_notes: Reservation required via LibCal; check in at the Reference Desk on the upper level.

cards.title: CSIL Lounge
cards.subtitle: New Building Room L2.71
cards.notes: Connect with student clubs or find out about campus events at this hub on the second floor. It serves as a central meeting point for student life.
cards.short_summary: The main office and lounge area for student organizations and campus activities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Student Involvement & Leadership is located in Room L2.71.00 of the New Building.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement & Leadership | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during business hours for club information and social interaction.

cards.title: Lynch Theater Lobby
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall Exhibition Space
cards.notes: Check out the rotating art exhibitions in the theater lobby. This space often hosts student-led performances and community events.
cards.short_summary: A performance venue lobby that doubles as an exhibition space for the college.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gerald W. Lynch Theater lobby is listed as an exhibition space at John Jay College.
cards.source_title: Public Transit Details - Shiva Gallery
cards.access_notes: Accessible during theater events and gallery hours in Haaren Hall.

cards.title: Student Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: New Building 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Grab a meal at the main campus cafeteria. It features various food stations and provides direct access to the outdoor Jay Walk.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus cafeteria located on the second floor of the New Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Dining Hall is located on the 2nd floor of the New Building (NB).
cards.source_title: Campus Dining - John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. during the semester.

cards.title: Honors Program Lounge
cards.subtitle: New Building Student Space
cards.notes: A dedicated space for Honors students to study, eat lunch, and collaborate. It includes computer stations and comfortable seating.
cards.short_summary: A community lounge specifically for students in the John Jay Honors Program.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honors Program lounge features computer rows and tables where students gather for lunch and schoolwork.
cards.source_title: Mental Health in the Honors Program - John Jay Sentinel
cards.access_notes: Access is typically restricted to students enrolled in the Honors or Macaulay Honors programs.

cards.title: Memorial Hall
cards.subtitle: 9/11 Memorial Space
cards.notes: Reflect at this memorial space within the college that honors the victims of the September 11 attacks, including many John Jay alumni.
cards.short_summary: A commemorative hall and exhibition space dedicated to the memory of 9/11.
cards.evidence_claim: Memorial Hall is listed as a significant campus space and exhibition area at John Jay College.
cards.source_title: Public Transit Details - Shiva Gallery
cards.access_notes: Located within the main campus buildings; accessible during standard college hours.

boards.school_name: CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at John Jay College, from rooftop gardens and art galleries to student-only lounges and recreation facilities.

cards.title: The Jay Walk
cards.subtitle: Rooftop Green Space
cards.notes: Relax on this 1.5-acre rooftop commons connecting Haaren Hall and the New Building. It features lawns, dining terraces, and wireless access for outdoor study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A massive rooftop park and garden connecting the college's main buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jay Walk is a rooftop outdoor environment that serves as a connection between Haaren Hall and the New Building, featuring lawns, patios, and wireless access.
cards.source_title: Jay Walk Use Policies & Operating Hours - John Jay College of Criminal Justice
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:45AM-10:00PM, with shorter hours on weekends. Accessible via the 2nd floor of the New Building or Haaren Hall.

cards.title: Anya and Andrew Shiva Gallery
cards.subtitle: Social Justice Art Gallery
cards.notes: Visit this 4,050-square-foot gallery in the New Building to view rotating art exhibitions focused on social justice, human rights, and the humanities.
cards.short_summary: The primary fine art gallery at John Jay, featuring social justice-themed exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Anya and Andrew Shiva Gallery is the primary fine art gallery at John Jay College and admission is free.
cards.source_title: Anya and Andrew Shiva Gallery at John Jay College of Criminal Justice - Directory - e-flux
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Located on the ground floor of the New Building.

cards.title: Lynn and Jules Kroll Atrium
cards.subtitle: New Building Social Hub
cards.notes: Meet up in this sun-drenched indoor foyer at the 59th Street entrance. It serves as a major pedestrian thoroughfare and a vibrant social gathering spot for students.
cards.short_summary: A large, glass-walled indoor atrium used for student gatherings and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lynn and Jules Kroll Atrium is a vibrant indoor environment located at the 59th street entrance that serves as a major pedestrian thoroughfare for students.
cards.source_title: EVENTS HANDBOOK - John Jay College of Criminal Justice
cards.access_notes: Accessible during regular college operating hours via the 59th Street entrance.

cards.title: Hound Square
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Plaza
cards.notes: Gather at this central campus plaza for student-led events, tabling, and casual hangouts. It is a primary outdoor social zone for the Bloodhound community.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor plaza used for student activities and community gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Hound Square is listed as a primary campus location for student events and gatherings.
cards.source_title: Events | John Jay College of Criminal Justice
cards.access_notes: Open public-access outdoor space within the campus perimeter.

cards.title: Lloyd Sealy Library Lounges
cards.subtitle: Niederhoffer Lounge
cards.notes: Study or relax in the Niederhoffer Lounge located on the first floor of the library. It provides a comfortable, quiet environment for individual or group work.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study lounges located within the college's main criminal justice library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Niederhoffer Lounge is located on the first floor of the Lloyd Sealy Library and serves as a study space for students.
cards.source_title: Lloyd Sealy Library - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Located in Haaren Hall. Open during library hours; valid CUNY ID required for entry.

cards.title: New Building Cyber Lounge
cards.subtitle: 1st Floor Tech Space
cards.notes: Access computers and lounge seating in this tech-focused student space on the first floor of the New Building. Ideal for quick browsing between classes.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge equipped with computers and seating in the New Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cyber Lounge in the New Building (1st floor) is an open-access facility funded by the Student Technology Fee.
cards.source_title: Cyber Cafe & Lounges - John Jay College of Criminal Justice
cards.access_notes: Available to students when the college is open. Located on the 1st floor.

cards.title: Haaren Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Historic Skylit Lobby
cards.notes: Enjoy the architecture of the renovated 1903 building in this skylit central atrium. It features seating areas and serves as the heart of the historic campus wing.
cards.short_summary: A central, skylit atrium in the historic Haaren Hall building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Haaren Hall modernization includes a renovated atrium lobby with a seating area and a new energy-efficient skylight.
cards.source_title: Haaren Hall Transformation Updates - John Jay College of Criminal Justice
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the 10th Avenue or 59th Street entrances during building hours.

cards.title: Cardiovascular Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Free Student Recreation
cards.notes: Stay active for free at the campus fitness center. Matriculated students get full access to gym equipment and recreation facilities with a valid ID.
cards.short_summary: On-campus gym facilities available at no extra cost to enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: All John Jay matriculated students are granted FREE access to recreation facilities with a valid student ID.
cards.source_title: Memberships & Schedules - John Jay College Athletics
cards.access_notes: Located in Haaren Hall, Suite 601. Requires a valid John Jay student ID.

cards.title: Wellness Center Workshops
cards.subtitle: Free Health & Support Events
cards.notes: Participate in free workshops and support groups like 'Sistah Circle' at the Wellness Center. These sessions offer social support and community engagement.
cards.short_summary: Free social and educational workshops hosted by the college Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Center offers free, confidential individual and group counseling and social support meetings like Sistah Circle.
cards.source_title: Events & Workshops - John Jay College of Criminal Justice
cards.access_notes: Located in the New Building, Room L.67/L.68. Workshops are held throughout the semester.

cards.title: CUNY Arts Museum Access
cards.subtitle: Free NYC Museum Entry
cards.notes: Use your John Jay ID for free admission to world-class NYC museums like MoMA and the Whitney through the CUNY Arts initiative. Just show your ID at the desk.
cards.short_summary: Free admission to major NYC museums for students with a valid CUNY ID.
cards.evidence_claim: CUNY students receive free admission to select museums including MoMA and the Whitney with proof of student ID through the CUNY Arts initiative.
cards.source_title: CUNY Free Admission to Museums - Resources for Hunter College Students
cards.access_notes: Available at participating institutions citywide; requires a current semester sticker on your ID.

boards.school_name: CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Navigate the vertical campus of John Jay with these ten distinct study environments, from high-tech library rooms to sun-drenched lounges and outdoor rooftop lawns.

cards.entity_name: Lloyd Sealy Library Individual Study Rooms
cards.title: Private Focus in Quiet South
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall, Upper Level
cards.notes: Reserve one of four individual rooms in the Quiet Study Area South for exams or Zoom calls. Rooms 1 and 2 include PCs and webcams for student use.
cards.short_summary: Single-occupancy reservable rooms located in the library's designated quiet zone.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers four individual study rooms in Quiet Study Area South; rooms 1 and 2 have desktop computers and webcams.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Lloyd Sealy Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; check in at the Upper Level Reference Desk with confirmation email.

cards.entity_name: Lloyd Sealy Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Collaborative Tech Hubs
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall, Levels 1 & 2
cards.notes: Book rooms A through D for group projects. These spaces feature plug-and-play screen technology with HDMI plugs for laptop screen sharing.
cards.short_summary: Tech-equipped rooms designed for student groups of up to five people.
cards.evidence_claim: Group study rooms A, B, C, and D are enhanced with plug-and-play screen technology and HDMI plugs for devices.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Lloyd Sealy Library
cards.access_notes: Available for groups of 2-5 students; whiteboard markers and adapters available at the Reference Desk.

cards.title: Rooftop Green Space
cards.subtitle: New Building, Level 2
cards.notes: Study on the 60,000-square-foot rooftop park connecting the New Building and Haaren Hall. Features wireless access, benches, and lawn areas.
cards.short_summary: An elevated outdoor campus park with seating and Wi-Fi for open-air studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jay Walk is a rooftop outdoor environment with wireless access, patios, decks, benches, and lawn areas for student use.
cards.source_title: Jay Walk Use Policies & Operating Hours
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:45AM-10:00PM; hours vary on weekends. Subject to weather closures.

cards.title: The Social Spine Cascade
cards.subtitle: New Building, 59th St Entrance
cards.notes: Utilize the 'cascade' amphitheater seating for casual reading. This sun-drenched foyer serves as a major pedestrian thoroughfare and information hub.
cards.short_summary: A vibrant indoor foyer with tiered seating and floor-to-ceiling glass walls.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kroll Atrium features cascade seating and benches for students to enjoy the space and refreshments.
cards.source_title: John Jay College Events Handbook
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during building hours; often used for event registration and information distribution.

cards.title: Second Floor Tech Lounge
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Find a spot in this tech-focused lounge located near the library. It provides open access to computing resources funded by the Student Tech Fee.
cards.short_summary: A student technology lounge in the historic Haaren Hall building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cyber Lounge in Haaren Hall is located on the 2nd floor and is open when the building is open.
cards.source_title: Campus Computer Labs - John Jay College
cards.access_notes: Open access for students; generally available during college operating hours.

cards.title: First Floor Digital Space
cards.subtitle: New Building, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Located on the ground level of the New Building, this lounge offers a convenient place to work between classes with campus network access.
cards.short_summary: A modern computer-equipped study lounge on the New Building's first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cyber Lounge in the New Building is located on the 1st floor and provides general maintenance and support for tech-fee funded areas.
cards.source_title: Cyber Cafe & Lounges - John Jay College
cards.access_notes: Access is available when the college is open; supported by Classroom Lab Support Services.

cards.title: Library Entrance Seating
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Located just inside the library's first-floor entrance, this lounge is named for founding faculty member Arthur Niederhoffer and offers immediate study access.
cards.short_summary: A historic lounge area located at the main entrance of the Lloyd Sealy Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor entrance of the library is flanked by the Reserve Room computer lab and the Niederhoffer Lounge.
cards.source_title: Lloyd Sealy Library - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; no reservation required for general lounge seating.

cards.title: Student Engagement Hub
cards.subtitle: New Building, Level L2
cards.notes: Visit the newly renovated $7 million open space in the Center for Student Involvement and Leadership (CSIL) for collaborative work and club meetings.
cards.short_summary: A large, open-plan student space on level L2 dedicated to club collaboration and community.
cards.evidence_claim: Club Row is an open space on L2 in the Center for Student Involvement and Leadership (CSIL) where clubs convene and collaborate.
cards.source_title: Club Row Set to Open After Nearly Five Years
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; clubs may reserve specific sections for meetings.

cards.title: Sky-Lit Bridge Workspace
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Study on the newly renovated bridge featuring an energy-efficient skylight and updated finishes. This space offers a unique vantage point over the atrium.
cards.short_summary: A modern student workspace located on the bridge overlooking the Haaren Hall atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: Renovations in Haaren Hall included a new energy efficient 2nd floor bridge and a new student workspace on the bridge.
cards.source_title: Haaren Hall Transformation Updates
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; features new lighting and wayfinding monitors.

cards.title: Art-Infused Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: New Building, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Find a quiet corner near the 4,000-square-foot gallery. The space features social justice-themed exhibitions and a reconfigurable multi-purpose area.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor art gallery space that offers a quiet, contemplative environment for study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Anya and Andrew Shiva Gallery is a 4,000-square-foot facility on the ground floor of the New Building, open Monday-Friday.
cards.source_title: About Us – Shiva Gallery
cards.access_notes: Viewing hours are Monday-Friday 10 AM – 5 PM; the space is reconfigurable for exhibitions.

boards.school_name: CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the immediate blocks surrounding John Jay College in Midtown West, featuring essential student resources, green spaces, and local landmarks.

cards.title: Emergency Care and Volunteering
cards.subtitle: West 59th Street
cards.notes: Located directly across from the college, this hospital provides 24/7 emergency services and clinical volunteer opportunities for students.
cards.short_summary: A major medical center offering emergency services and student volunteer programs directly across from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mount Sinai West is located at 1000 Tenth Avenue with its emergency department on 59th Street between 9th and 10th Avenues.
cards.source_title: About Mount Sinai West
cards.access_notes: The emergency department is open 24/7.

cards.title: Historic Flemish Baroque Facade
cards.subtitle: 10th Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the landmarked 1903 building on 10th Avenue, which houses the world's largest criminal justice library and a skylit atrium.
cards.short_summary: The historic heart of the college, featuring a landmarked facade and the Lloyd Sealy Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Haaren Hall is a landmarked 1903 Flemish Baroque building located at 899 Tenth Avenue.
cards.source_title: John Jay College of Criminal Justice - Rafael Viñoly Architects
cards.access_notes: Access is restricted to students and authorized visitors with ID.

cards.title: Community Service and Recreation
cards.subtitle: West 58th Street
cards.notes: Participate in annual park clean-up events or use the athletic fields located just two blocks west of the main campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public park used for student community service projects and recreational activities.
cards.evidence_claim: John Jay College hosts annual DeWitt Clinton Park clean-up events for students to beautify the local 9/11 memorial.
cards.source_title: Events | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from 6:00 AM to 1:00 AM.

cards.title: Modern Architectural Masterpiece
cards.subtitle: 11th Avenue
cards.notes: Enter through the 11th Avenue side to see the 14-story 'cube' tower and the 65,000-square-foot rooftop greenbelt known as the Jay Walk.
cards.short_summary: A modern 13-story vertical campus building featuring high-tech labs and a massive rooftop commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Building at John Jay College features a 65,000-square-foot landscaped terrace known as the Jay Walk.
cards.source_title: John Jay College of Criminal Justice - Expansion Project - SOM
cards.access_notes: Campus ID required for entry to interior spaces.

cards.title: Major Transportation Hub
cards.subtitle: Columbus Circle
cards.notes: Access the A, C, B, D, and 1 subway lines at this major hub located just two blocks east of the college campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary subway station serving John Jay College, providing access to multiple Manhattan lines.
cards.evidence_claim: The 59th St-Columbus Circle station is the primary subway stop for John Jay College, serving the A, B, C, D, and 1 lines.
cards.source_title: Directions - John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours for transit access.

cards.title: 24-Hour Grocery Access
cards.subtitle: 9th Avenue
cards.notes: This 24-hour supermarket at 59th Street and 9th Avenue provides essential grocery and prepared food options for students.
cards.short_summary: A conveniently located 24-hour grocery store serving the student population near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Morton Williams has a location at 917 Ninth Avenue (at 59th Street) that is open 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: LOCATIONS | mortonwilliams
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Off-Campus Student Housing
cards.subtitle: West 60th Street
cards.notes: Located one block north, this residential building is a popular off-campus housing choice for students attending John Jay and nearby colleges.
cards.short_summary: A luxury residential building frequently used for off-campus student housing near Columbus Circle.
cards.evidence_claim: Anagram Columbus Circle at 1 West 60th Street provides housing for students attending John Jay College and other nearby institutions.
cards.source_title: Anagram Columbus Circle - New York Apartment Rentals
cards.access_notes: Private residential building; access restricted to residents and guests.

cards.title: Natural and Organic Foods
cards.subtitle: 8th Avenue
cards.notes: A long-standing health food store at 54th Street and 8th Avenue offering organic produce and natural products for health-conscious students.
cards.short_summary: A popular health food market located a few blocks south of the college campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerly Natural Market is located at 911 8th Avenue and is known for organic produce and natural foods.
cards.source_title: Westerly Natural Market
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 12:00 AM.

cards.title: Architectural Landmark
cards.subtitle: West 57th Street
cards.notes: Observe the striking diagrid architecture of this landmark tower, located just two blocks south of the college's main buildings.
cards.short_summary: A world-renowned architectural landmark located on 57th Street near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hearst Tower is located at 300 West 57th Street, two blocks south of John Jay College.
cards.source_title: 57th Street (Manhattan) - Wikipedia
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is free; interior access is restricted.

cards.title: TV Production District
cards.subtitle: West 54th Street
cards.notes: Walk past the studios where major television shows are taped, reflecting the neighborhood's role as a media and production hub.
cards.short_summary: A nearby street known for hosting television production studios and media offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Daily Show was historically taped at studios on West 54th Street and 11th Avenue in Hell's Kitchen.
cards.source_title: Self Guided - Hell's Kitchen Tour - Free Tours by Foot
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing of studios is public.

boards.school_name: CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and annual events that define the Bloodhound spirit at John Jay College of Criminal Justice.

cards.title: 9/11 Flag Planting
cards.subtitle: A visual tribute on the Jay Walk
cards.notes: Join the annual tradition of planting 2,977 flags on the Jay Walk to honor lives lost on 9/11, including 67 flags specifically for John Jay's fallen heroes.
cards.short_summary: An annual memorial event where students and faculty plant thousands of flags on the campus rooftop garden.
cards.evidence_claim: In 2013, the College began its annual tradition of planting 2,977 flags on the Jay Walk, each one symbolizing a life lost on 9/11.
cards.source_title: 9/11 Memorial | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: The event takes place annually in September on the Jay Walk rooftop space.

cards.title: Bloodhound Thursday
cards.subtitle: Monthly campus pride celebration
cards.notes: Wear your blue and gold every month for Bloodhound Thursday to celebrate campus pride with games and community building in Hound Square.
cards.short_summary: A monthly spirit day featuring community events and school colors to foster campus identity.
cards.evidence_claim: Bloodhound Thursday is John Jay's monthly tradition to celebrate campus pride, build community & bring people together in a fun and spirited way.
cards.source_title: Bloodhound Thursday - John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Held monthly during the academic semester, typically in Hound Square.

cards.title: The John Jay Mace
cards.subtitle: Symbol of academic authority
cards.notes: Observe the 29-inch blue and gold mace, created in 1968 by a student detective, as it leads the academic procession at commencement.
cards.short_summary: A ceremonial staff designed by a student and police detective that serves as a symbol of authority at graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: The John Jay College mace was created in 1968 by Anthony T. Muratore, a student and police detective. It is 29 inches long, in blue and gold.
cards.source_title: Commencement 2018 - John Jay College of Criminal Justice
cards.access_notes: Displayed primarily during the annual Commencement ceremony at Barclays Center.

cards.title: Gaypril
cards.subtitle: Month-long LGBTQ+ celebration
cards.notes: Participate in Gaypril every April, featuring events like Gay Bingo and drag shows to celebrate the LGBTQIA+ community on campus.
cards.short_summary: A month of programming in April dedicated to LGBTQ+ history, joy, and community resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Every April we celebrate Gaypril along with our LGBTQ+ Resource Center: an entire month dedicated to the LGBTQIA+ community at John Jay.
cards.source_title: Activities & Events | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Events are held throughout the month of April across various campus locations.

cards.title: Mother Africa Showcase
cards.subtitle: Cultural fashion and performance show
cards.notes: Attend the annual Mother Africa Showcase in the Gerald W. Lynch Theater to see the African diaspora celebrated through fashion and dance.
cards.short_summary: A student-led spring showcase highlighting the diversity of African cultures through performance and style.
cards.evidence_claim: The African Student Association held their 3rd annual Mother Africa Showcase this spring in the Gerald W. Lynch Theater.
cards.source_title: African Student Association Hosts Spring Fashion Show - John Jay Sentinel
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the spring semester at the Gerald W. Lynch Theater.

cards.title: CSIL Awards
cards.subtitle: Annual student leadership recognition
cards.notes: Celebrate the achievements of student leaders and welcome new executives at the annual CSIL Awards ceremony held every spring.
cards.short_summary: A formal ceremony recognizing the hard work and leadership of students involved in campus organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Every Spring, we recognize our student leaders during our annual CSIL Awards for all of the hard work they put forth.
cards.source_title: Activities & Events | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: An annual spring event for the student leadership community.

cards.title: Fierce Advocates for Justice
cards.subtitle: The college's guiding motto
cards.notes: Embrace the 'Fierce Advocates for Justice' motto, which appears on campus signage and is frequently invoked during student speeches and ceremonies.
cards.short_summary: The official motto and identity of John Jay students, reflecting the school's mission in criminal justice.
cards.evidence_claim: Motto: 'Fierce Advocates for Justice.' ... John Jay College educates fierce advocates for justice, a calling that demands robust debate.
cards.source_title: About | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Visible throughout the campus and used in all official college communications.

cards.title: The Bloodhound Mascot
cards.subtitle: Unique collegiate mascot
cards.notes: Meet the Bloodhound, the only mascot of its kind in college sports, representing the school's focus on investigation and justice.
cards.short_summary: John Jay is the only university in the world to use a Bloodhound as its official athletic mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: John Jay is the only university to have a Bloodhound as a mascot. ... there is one, and only one team, at any level of college or professional sports to have a bloodhound.
cards.source_title: Fairfield – John Jay Early Edition Game Notes 24-25 - 240
cards.access_notes: The mascot appears at athletic events and major campus celebrations like Bloodhound Thursday.

cards.title: Founders Day / Anniversary Celebration
cards.subtitle: Commemorating the college's 1964 founding
cards.notes: Join the campus-wide celebration of John Jay's founding, featuring games, live music, and fellowship in the Kroll Atrium and Hound Square.
cards.short_summary: A recurring milestone event celebrating the history and evolution of the college since its 1964 establishment.
cards.evidence_claim: In honor of our 60th anniversary... we are hosting a celebration for the entire College on Thursday, November 20, 2025.
cards.source_title: 60 Year Anniversary Campus Celebration | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Major anniversary celebrations are held periodically, with the 60th anniversary occurring in late 2025.

cards.title: Peer Ambassador Tradition
cards.subtitle: Student leadership and service
cards.notes: Look for Peer Ambassadors in their signature gear as they guide new students through orientation and represent the college at major events.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing student leadership program where experienced students mentor and assist the incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: A Peer Ambassador functions as a representative of Student Transition Programs at John Jay College... providing support to incoming students.
cards.source_title: Meet the Team | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Peer Ambassadors are active year-round, especially during orientation and commencement.

boards.school_name: CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice
boards.title: Your First Weekend at CUNY John Jay College of Criminal Justice, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Kick Off Your Journey
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide Orientation Sessions
cards.notes: Start your weekend by attending the official orientation to meet classmates and learn about campus resources. Check-in typically begins at 8:30 AM in the New Building.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome program for new students to connect with the John Jay community.
cards.evidence_claim: New Student Orientation for First-Year students includes in-person sessions starting at 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM on scheduled dates in August.
cards.source_title: First-Year Orientation | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Registration through the New Student Portal is required to attend specific sessions.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Haaren Hall, Floors 1 & 2
cards.notes: Visit the world-renowned criminal justice collection. Use the computer labs or find a quiet corner in the Niederhoffer Lounge to plan your first week.
cards.short_summary: A premier research library specializing in criminal justice with extensive study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lloyd Sealy Library is located on the first two floors of Haaren Hall and includes study spaces and computer labs.
cards.source_title: About Lloyd Sealy Library | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 9am-7:45pm and Friday 9am-4:45pm; weekend hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Relax on the Rooftop
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Plaza above 59th Street
cards.notes: Walk the elevated green space connecting Haaren Hall and the New Building. It's a perfect spot for a midday break with views of the Midtown skyline.
cards.short_summary: A unique 5th-floor rooftop park and garden serving as a central campus social hub.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jay Walk is a rooftop outdoor environment that serves as a connection between Haaren Hall and the New Building.
cards.source_title: Jay Walk Use Policies & Operating Hours - John Jay College
cards.access_notes: Standard hours include Saturday 7:45 AM to 6:00 PM and Sunday 9:00 AM to 3:15 PM.

cards.title: Grab a Campus Bite
cards.subtitle: New Building, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Fuel up between orientation sessions with pizza, pasta, or international fusions. Check out the Kosher to-go options near the entrance.
cards.short_summary: The main campus eatery offering diverse meal stations and rotating chef features.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Dining Hall is located on the 2nd floor of the New Building and offers various food stations.
cards.source_title: Campus Dining - John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM and Friday until 2:00 PM; closed weekends.

cards.title: Picnic in the Park
cards.subtitle: Central Park, West 66th to 69th St
cards.notes: Walk four blocks east to Central Park's most famous lawn. It's a designated quiet zone, ideal for reading or a group picnic with new friends.
cards.short_summary: A massive 15-acre lawn in Central Park perfect for sunbathing and relaxing.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheep Meadow is a 15-acre lawn on the West Side between 66th and 69th Streets, popular for picnicking.
cards.source_title: Sheep Meadow | Central Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Opens daily at 11:00 AM; closed in winter for lawn restoration.

cards.title: Explore Social Justice Art
cards.subtitle: New Building, Ground Floor
cards.notes: Browse contemporary art focused on social issues and human rights. This 4,000-square-foot space is the college's primary fine art venue.
cards.short_summary: A fine art gallery at John Jay dedicated to themes of justice, politics, and social issues.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shiva Gallery is located on the ground floor of the New Building and is open Monday through Friday.
cards.source_title: About Us – Anya and Andrew Shiva Gallery
cards.access_notes: Viewing hours are Monday through Friday from 10 AM – 5 PM.

cards.title: Catch a World-Class Show
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Take advantage of your CUNY ID for $29 student rush tickets to the New York City Ballet or 50% off Chamber Music Society performances.
cards.short_summary: Discounted access to premier performing arts including ballet, opera, and classical music.
cards.evidence_claim: CUNY students can access $29 student rush tickets for the New York City Ballet and 50% off for the Chamber Music Society.
cards.source_title: Student Discounts - CUNY SPH
cards.access_notes: Valid student ID required; rush tickets are typically available on the day of the performance.

cards.title: Stroll Along the Hudson
cards.subtitle: West 59th to 72nd Street
cards.notes: Walk west to the Hudson River to find soccer fields, basketball courts, and a scenic esplanade. It's a great spot for sunset views.
cards.short_summary: A waterfront park featuring recreational facilities and historic railroad remains.
cards.evidence_claim: Riverside Park South is located between West 59th and West 71st Streets along the Hudson River.
cards.source_title: Riverside Park South - NYC Parks
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily; features Wi-Fi hot spots and public restrooms.

cards.title: Shop and Explore
cards.subtitle: 10 Columbus Circle
cards.notes: Visit this nearby hub for essentials at Whole Foods or browse the Apple Store. It's a convenient indoor space for shopping and dining.
cards.short_summary: An upscale shopping center and culinary destination located at the southwest corner of Central Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Shops at Columbus Circle is a major retail and dining destination located at 10 Columbus Circle.
cards.source_title: About - The Shops at Columbus Circle
cards.access_notes: Open daily; hours are typically 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM (7:00 PM on Sundays).

cards.title: Get Your Spirit Gear
cards.subtitle: New Building, L2 Club Row
cards.notes: Pick up your first John Jay hoodie or t-shirt at the campus merchandise store. It's the go-to spot for showing your Bloodhound pride.
cards.short_summary: The official campus store for John Jay branded apparel, gifts, and accessories.
cards.evidence_claim: Bloodhound Depot is the campus merchandise store located in the Club Row on L2 of the New Building.
cards.source_title: Bloodhound Depot | John Jay College of Criminal Justice - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday with varying hours; closed on weekends.
